## Description
Briefly describe the purpose of this Pull Request and what changes were made.

## Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update (e.g., README, guides, demo scripts)
- [ ] 🗣️ Content update (new Kannada phrases, roleplays, or phonetics)
- [ ] ♿ Accessibility improvement (WCAG AA compliance, aria labels)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization (bundle size, audio latency)

## Verification Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project's Conventional Commits standard.
- [ ] I have run `npm test` and all unit/component tests pass.
- [ ] I have run `npm run typecheck` with 0 TypeScript errors.
- [ ] I have run `npm run lint` with 0 ESLint errors.
- [ ] I have run `npm run validate` (or `go test ./...` in `tools/validate`) if content changed.
- [ ] I have run `npm run build` and verified the production PWA bundle builds cleanly.
- [ ] If adding UI, I tested keyboard navigation and color contrast.

## Screenshots / Evidence
Add screenshots or screen recordings showcasing the feature or fix if applicable.
